title: 2019 Ford Fiesta ST
longDescription: A small but lively hot hatch that feels quick, nimble, and easy to control. The Fiesta ST is a great choice for players who want sharp handling, decent speed, and a fun lightweight car that is easy to throw through traffic.

title: 2019 Volkswagen Golf GTI Mk8
longDescription: The Golf GTI is a strong all-rounder that mixes everyday usability with sporty performance. It offers more power and stability than smaller hot hatches, making it a dependable choice for players who want a fast but well-balanced car.

title: 2014 Mazda MX-5 Miata
longDescription: A lightweight rear-wheel-drive roadster that focuses on agility and driver feel rather than raw power. The MX-5 is an ideal starter car because it is predictable, fun to drive, and teaches the player how to handle corners and traffic smoothly.

title: 2025 BMW 330i
longDescription: The BMW 330i delivers strong turbocharged performance in a more refined and premium package. It feels stable at speed, has solid acceleration, and suits players who want a comfortable but still sporty car for longer, faster runs.

title: 2015 Mclaren 650s
longDescription: A brutal supercar built for speed, precision, and excitement. The McLaren 650S combines huge power with a relatively light body, making it a dangerous but rewarding machine for players who can handle very high speeds and rapid reactions.

title: 2015 Lamborghini Huracan
longDescription: The Huracan is a dramatic high-performance supercar with a powerful V10 engine and aggressive character. It offers massive speed and strong presence, making it perfect for players who want a loud, flashy, and thrilling car at the top end of the garage.

title: 2015 Ferrari 458
longDescription: The Ferrari 458 is a sharp and responsive supercar known for its high-revving engine and precise performance. It feels fast, special, and highly rewarding, making it a top-tier choice for players who want speed with classic Italian style.
